defs.def: land that is under the control of a particular country or ruler 领土；版图；领地

ex.s: Now, UNICEF has been working to improve the lives of children and their families across 190 countries and territories.
ex.t: 如今，联合国儿童基金会一直在努力改善190个国家和领地的儿童及其家庭的生活。

ex.s: Tan Dun, composer 4 “There is no territory in the world of music.” These are the words of Chinese composer Tan Dun.
ex.t: 谭盾，作曲家 4 “音乐世界里没有疆界。” 这是中国作曲家谭盾的话。

ex.s: However true this is, we also need to consider that some of these so-called “urban animals” have never moved at all ‒ it’s we humans who have moved into their territory.
ex.t: 无论这是否属实，我们也需要考虑到，这些所谓的“城市动物”中有些根本没动过——是我们人类搬进了它们的领地。

ex.s: In more recent times, Norwegian explorer, Roald Amundsen endured one of the most hostile environments on Earth when he set out into uncharted territory to reach the South Pole – a region of the planet ripe for exploration.
ex.t: 近代，挪威探险家罗尔德·阿蒙森在向无人涉足的领地进发、前往南极——地球上一块亟待探索的区域——时，忍受了地球上最严酷的环境之一。

defs.def: an area that one person, group, animal, etc. considers as their own and defends against others who try to enter it （个人、群体、动物等占据的）领域，管区，地盘
an area of a town, country, etc. that sb has responsibility for in their work or another activity （某人负责的）地区
a particular type of land （某类）地区；（某种）地方
a country or an area that is part of the US, Australia or Canada but is not a state or province （美国）准州；（澳大利亚）地区；（加拿大）地区

ex.s: The province of Newfoundland and Labrador is divided into two unequal areas: Labrador is the much larger mainland territory to the north, while Newfoundland is the smaller island to the south.
ex.t: 纽芬兰与拉布拉多省分为两个面积不等的部分：拉布拉多是北部大得多的本土大陆区域，而纽芬兰是南部较小的岛屿。
